banner.porQueNuestrasCarillas: Why our veneers look so natural
banner.laGranMayoriaDe: Most cosmetic treatments fail because they look like a solid, opaque, lifeless block. At Odontogamma Oriente, Dr. Jaime Arcila shapes every piece to respect the horizontal and vertical micro-texture of natural enamel.
banner.estoSignificaQueCuando: This means that when light hits your teeth, it reflects diffusely, just as it does on a young natural tooth, so your veneers look natural and are hard to tell apart from your own teeth.
